code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    nonbackground = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != background)
    marker = nonbackground.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objects = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] != marker]
    anchors = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in objects); r1 = max(r for r, c in objects)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in objects); c1 = max(c for r, c in objects)
    pattern = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    cr, cc = (r1 - r0) // 2, (c1 - c0) // 2
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ar, ac in anchors:
        for i, row in enumerate(pattern):
            for j, value in enumerate(row):
                rr, col = ar + i - cr, ac + j - cc
                if value != background and 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= col < w:
                    out[rr][col] = value
    return out
'''
